text: {"lessons":["My account fell from 104,088 to 96,539, so doing nothing avoided rash trades but did not manage the decline; I should review whether my risk still fits my goals.","I should not keep a losing stock merely to avoid admitting a mistake, or treat each stock as a separate account; decisions should reflect its outlook and my portfolio as a whole.","Since I check only occasionally, I should schedule periodic reviews and set clear, evidence-based rules for rebalancing or selling before the next downturn."]}
